hypothesis.statement: On real GRABMyo forearm EMG (10-muscle set), the ecosystem's inter-muscle coordination network reproduces across two independent data halves: coherence edges and topology reproduce near-perfectly (edge r ~0.99, node-strength r ~0.997), and the partial-coherence, wPLI, and directed-Granger EDGES reproduce too (r >= 0.83) -- the connectivity structure is signal, not split-specific noise.

analysis_plan.dataset: GRABMyo (PhysioNet v1.1.0), session1 participant1, forearm EMG channels 1-10 @ 2048 Hz; split-half reproducibility of four connectivity estimators

decision.threshold: descriptive: per-estimator split-half correlation of edge weights (upper triangle) and node strengths (row sums); a value near 1 means each half rebuilds the same network -- trust the estimators whose edges AND topology both reproduce
